notes: Firm-level purchase score at each monthly rebalance, timestamped on filing date, trailing window W = 90 calendar days, cluster λ = 0.5. ADV20 is the universe 20-day median dollar volume at t (SPEC writes average; the screen is a median and the signal reuses it). Opportunistic coverage: median 46 names (3.3% of the universe) with a nonzero score per month; all-insider coverage: median 221 (15.9%). Go/no-go failed: opportunistic 21d IC +0.0165 (t = 2.16), 63d IC +0.0157 (t = 1.54). The CMP filter's lift versus all insiders is indistinguishable from zero at the gate horizons. The signal was not retuned to clear the hurdle. Built in 1.7s.

go_no_go.criterion: Opportunistic-filtered mean Spearman IC at the 21- and 63-day horizons is positive with Newey-West t-statistic ≥ 2.
go_no_go.verdict: Gate failed. The opportunistic-filtered signal does not clear the pre-registered hurdle at 63d (21d mean IC +0.0165 (t = 2.16), 63d mean IC +0.0157 (t = 1.54)). The honest reading is post-publication decay, not a tradable anomaly: Milestone 5 still runs so the decay is documented with an equity curve, but the narrative is a well-executed decay study.
